requirements.scope: K01 release requirements used by Gate04E and production release

parameters.scope: Gate04E P006 service structural screen + current FEMM screening
parameters.authority: controlled engineering parameters; values are inputs to the build graph and are not duplicated in the Command Center UI

interface_parameters.authority: controlled design parameters; CAD semantic readback must verify rather than silently redefine them

interface_parameters.policy: These values are machine state. Command Center HTML must not duplicate them as literals. A controlled parameter revision is required to change them.

materials.note: This file does not assert that every K01 assembly component uses 1.4404. It controls only the current P003/P007 structural service model material state. Other parts retain their own controlled/open material identities.
